name: Pivot
summary: Step around your backhand corner to play a forehand from there.
whenToUse: When a ball to your backhand is attackable and your forehand is your stronger weapon.

keyPoints.stance: From ready, slightly toward the backhand.
keyPoints.bodyAction: A small step left with the left foot (right foot if left-handed), then swing the right foot (left foot if left-handed) back and around behind you, ending side-on.
keyPoints.strokeLength: Footwork only; the forehand follows as you finish turning.
keyPoints.timing: Decide early: the pivot takes time.
keyPoints.batArm: Back for the forehand as you land.
keyPoints.recovery: Back to the middle quickly: the wide forehand is open.
keyPoints.anticipation: Only pivot when you are sure you can attack.

learningPath.passCheck: You can say the three cues.
10 reps, then yes to the self-checks.
selfChecks: Was the first step back and around?
Did you recover to the middle?

learningPath.task: Middle, then pivot from the backhand corner, slowly.
Serve and pivot-attack the third ball.
learningPath.passCheck: 6 of 10 third balls on the table.

gamePatterns.situation: You serve short and the push comes long to your backhand.
gamePatterns.how: Pivot and loop with your forehand to their wide backhand or elbow.

fixes: Step back and around, not just sideways
Recover to the middle right after the shot

causes: Pivoting on balls you can't attack
fixes: Pivot only for balls you can attack; otherwise use the backhand
